title: Beyond the Evidence Boundary: Behavioral Mirage Under Progressive Degradation in Medical VLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.28000v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: VLMs for medical image interpretation are typically evaluated on clean inputs, despite the progressive evidence loss that can occur in high stakes clinical settings. Existing robustness studies show that performance can degrade while confidence remains high, but do not establish when a previously reliable model-case pair ceases to behave reliably. We introduce a baseline-anchored framework that traces baseline-correct cases through progressive image degradation to identify an empirical evidence boundary, and define mirage as continued commitment at this boundary, regardless of correctness. Across three VLMs on three medical datasets, only MedGemma provides a sufficiently large baseline-correct pool for trajectory analysis. On VQA-RAD, the only dataset in which the question text varies, language-only answerability is associated with baseline correctness (AUROC 0.677) and with commitment at the boundary (AUROC 0.653 to 0.670). translated_title: 超越证据边界：医学视觉语言模型在渐进性退化下的行为幻象
translated_abstract: 用于医学图像解读的视觉语言模型（VLM）通常是在干净输入上进行评估的，然而在高风险临床环境中可能发生渐进性的证据丢失。现有的鲁棒性研究表明，性能可能下降而置信度仍然保持很高，但并未确定一个先前可靠的模型-案例对何时会停止可靠运行。我们引入了一个以基线为锚点的框架，通过渐进性图像退化追踪基线正确的案例，以识别经验性的证据边界，并将“幻象”定义为无论正确与否，模型在该边界处仍继续坚持其原有判断的行为。在三个医学数据集上对三个VLM进行的实验中，只有MedGemma提供了足够大的基线正确样本池用于轨迹分析。在VQA-RAD（唯一一个问题文本会变化的数据集）上，仅凭语言文本即可回答的问题与基线正确性相关（AUROC 0.677），也与边界处的坚持行为相关（AUROC 0.653至0.670）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基线锚定框架，通过渐进性图像退化识别医学视觉语言模型的“证据边界”，并首次定义“行为幻象”现象——即模型在证据已不足以支持判断的边界处仍持续坚持原有回答，且发现仅凭文本即可回答的问题与该坚持行为显著相关。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a baseline-anchored framework to identify the empirical evidence boundary of medical VLMs under progressive image degradation, and defines "behavioral mirage" as a model's continued commitment at this boundary regardless of correctness, showing that language-only answerability is associated with such commitment.
